messages:
mike: Hey team — urgent: partner needs an epidural pump for chronic pain, supplier out-of-network. Procedure/placement scheduled in 10 days. Claim pended for no prior auth. Any fast route for authorization or single-case agreement?
ana: Hi Mike — we can do an expedited prior auth or a medical necessity exception. Need member ID, supplier quote, HCPCS/CPT, and clinician letter. DM those and tag benefits-bot.
benefits-bot: Please submit pre-auth at https://benefits.redwood.example.com/preauth with attachments: itemized quote, clinician letter, treatment plan, and supplier HCPCS (e.g., A4280). Mark as "Expedite" and include procedure date. Expedited turnaround ~72 hrs.
casey: If supplier claims no in-network option, ask for a short access statement and whether they accept direct billing. Also file a parallel pre-determination for OOP estimate. I can run a network search for any local in-network suppliers.
mike: Sending DM with member ID & quote now. Supplier included HCPCS and can direct-bill if payer accepts.
ana: Great — email people-ops@redwood.com with subject "URGENT: DME pre-auth Member 2XXXX" after form submission so we open a manual case. We'll route to a case manager and chase payer provider relations if needed.
casey: Template for vendor email (paste fields):

To: providerrelations@insurer.example.com
Subject: Urgent pre-auth request — Member 2XXXX — Epidural pump placement [YYYY-MM-DD]
Member: [name], DOB: [MM/DD/YYYY], Member ID: 2XXXX
Supplier: [name], NPI: [#####], HCPCS: [A4280]
Procedure date: [YYYY-MM-DD]
Attachments: quote, clinician letter, access statement
Request: expedited pre-auth + pre-determination; request direct billing acceptance

mike: Thanks — submitted form and emailed people-ops. Vendor uploaded final invoice and access note.
benefits-bot: Case created: PA-2026-1223. Assigned to casey. ETA: 72 hours for expedited review.
casey: I'll follow up with insurer/provider relations and post any ack here. If no response in 48 hrs, we'll escalate.
mike: Appreciate it — will update if vendor needs payer EDI.
